scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc -p e2e --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run e2e
